body: U+0023# 2026-10-03: water sparkles fixed in one masked pass, PR #261U+000AU+000AU+002A*Branch and PR.** The branch is `fix/meadow-water-marks-one-pass` (worktree `~/Documents/DevLabs/.fireplace-worktrees/water-marks-layer`), commit b4454b3d, PR #261, ready for review. `paintMeadowWaterMarks` now takes the `MeadowLayers`. It draws every mark in plain colour inside one saveLayer bounded by the water tiles and calls `maskToWater` once, as before #259.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Tests rewritten.**U+000AU+002D The layer-count test is now "exactly one layer when there are marks".U+000AU+002D The painter structure test now requires one layer, no shader or colour filter on the marks, and one dstIn mask per tile.U+000AU+002D The Impeller test now checks that marks appear only where the water is, with a mark straddling the shore, on both engines.U+000AU+002D The two structure tests fail against main's drawing and pass with the fix.U+000AU+002D The three noon Meadow goldens changed by at most 1/255, on the sun glare only.U+000AU+002D Full suite: 4,302 tests pass; analyze is clean. The tooling folder failed once under build load and passed alone (106).U+000AU+000AU+002A*Device proof, Note 10+, GPU uncapped, alternating with main.**U+000AU+002D Noon: 61.9 to 62.0 fps, raster p90 14.0 to 14.1 ms, against main's 36.1 to 36.4 fps and 29.5 to 29.7 ms.U+000AU+002D Midnight and unfocused keep-moving: 61.8 to 62.0 fps.U+000AU+002D Screenshots against main match within 2/255 at noon and exactly at midnight, on the glass and on Today. A live noon frame shows the full glint trail.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Lab Mac VM.** Noon 59.7 to 61.9 fps at 2.2 to 3.0 ms, against main's 7 to 7.6 fps at about 131 ms. Midnight 61.6 to 61.7 fps. VM released, nothing left behind.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Spec.** Criterion 10.8 is amended in the spec and record (title, text, three tests). Section 15 has a Fix paragraph. The decisions file records the owner's choice.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Not done.** The seeded and fresh apps on the Note 10+ and the Mac are still the main a13cd6e4 builds. Rebuild and reinstall them from main once #261 merges.
